item: Item 3: Ctrl-Shift-M in the waveform viewer should toggle single/multi plot mode (what Ctrl-Shift-4 does from the design window); today it pops "View is Read Only". Read-only scout, nothing run. Tree state at read time: HEAD is 7c77f3594 (the 1724/1657 work is committed on top of d36cb429e) and every file this item touches is clean in `git status`.
mechanism:
READ in code, not reproduced at runtime.

Path of Ctrl-Shift-M today (viewer canvas focused, pointer over a strip):
1. Tk delivers KeyPress keysym M (77), state Control|Shift (5). `wviewer::strip_bindings` (src/wave_viewer.tcl) makes the canvas bindtags {WvFszCanvas, <canvas>, WaveViewer, Canvas, <toplevel>, all}. The only key binding on the widget is `<KeyPress>` -> `wviewer::key_filter %W %T %x %y %N %K %s`.
2. `wviewer::key_filter`: `wviewer::case_keysym 77 5` keeps 77 (under Control the case is Shift XOR Lock). It is not f/Z/Ctrl-z/arrow/Escape. 77 is in `graphkeys` {97 98 100 115 109 116 65 66 77} and `wviewer::over_graph $W` is true, so `fwd = !((N==100||N==98) && (s&4))` = 1. Membership is by keysym only; the only modifier carve-outs are Ctrl-d and Ctrl-b. N is not 109/100, so it is forwarded raw (not inside `wviewer::with_edit`): `xschem callback $W 2 $x $y 77 0 0 5`.
3. C `callback()` strips Lock/Mod2, rstate = ControlMask, and calls `handle_key_press()`. `key_chord_has_binding(77, ControlMask)` is 0 (no row for 'M' in `init_input_bindings`; src/keybindings.csv has no 77 row), so it reaches `switch(key)`, `case 'M'`. The `rstate == 0` arm has the `waves_selected()` guard (Shift+M tooltip). The `rstate == ControlMask` arm opens with `if(readonly_block()) break;` and has no waves guard. The viewer buffer is read-only for life, so `readonly_block()` runs `tk_messageBox ... {View is Read Only. ...}`.
4. `key_filter` never `break`s, but no WaveViewer binding matches the chord (`wviewer::install_default_binds` has none for M; `wviewer::install_case_binds` covers only d g n w e u b c q v), so nothing else fires.

Pointer must be over a graph in the Tcl sense for the popup: `wviewer::over_graph` needs `xschem get current_win_path` to be this canvas and mousex_snap/mousey_snap inside a `graphbb` band. Otherwise `fwd` stays 0, the key is swallowed, no tag binding matches: silent no-op. The C arm itself does not look at the pointer.

Root cause shared by the family: `key_filter` allowlists by keysym, C re-decides by (key, modifier, mode) and by its own geometry, and several C arms for an allowlisted keysym are editor verbs with no waves guard. doc/claude/specs/graph_markers.md §6.1 records the same defect for Shift+M; that fix guarded only the rstate==0 arm.

How plot mode is changed today: Options > Plot Mode has one command entry, `-command [list wviewer::set_plot_mode invert $token]`, no accelerator; `wviewer::plot_mode_menu_post` relabels entry 0 from a -postcommand. `wviewer::set_plot_mode` writes the TARGET subwindow's mode (`wviewer::target_index`, moved by `wviewer::click_target` on ButtonPress-1), pushes `wviewer::status_refresh`, and logs `wviewer::set_plot_mode <resolved> <token>` on a real change. Ctrl-Shift-4 is `bind .drw <Control-Key-dollar>` / `<Control-Shift-Key-4>` -> `ase::plot_mode_for_current invert` in src/cadence_style_rc; those are widget-level binds that `strip_bindings` sweeps off a viewer canvas. There is no `..._at %W` wrapper for plot mode.

code_sites.role: Widget-level <KeyPress>/<KeyRelease> handler. The `graphkeys` arm sets `fwd` by keysym only (carve-outs for Ctrl-d, Ctrl-b); forwards m/d inside with_edit. Needs the Ctrl+M carve-out at minimum; the family fix belongs here (decide by chord, not keysym).
The allowlist {97 98 100 115 109 116 65 66 77}. Pinned byte-exactly by BK03 of test_wave_sigbrowser_keys; keep it unchanged and carve out by modifier, as R9 did for Ctrl-b.
Tcl gate for forwarding: context is this canvas and mousex_snap/mousey_snap inside a full graphbb band (no inset).

House pattern for viewer chords: `if {[bind WaveViewer <seq>] eq {}} { bind WaveViewer <seq> {wviewer::..._at %W; break} }`. Runs once per session. Existing spellings: <Control-Key-N>, <Control-Key-W>, <Control-Shift-Key-D>, <Control-Shift-Key-G>, <Key-E>, <Key-U>. The new default goes here as a literal sequence.

Caps Lock ruling 2026-10-16. A new Ctrl-letter chord needs a case_pairs row; M would be the first row with an empty LOWER base (`m {} <Control-Shift-Key-M>`). By reading, case_key returns on an empty seq and install_case_binds would also bind <Control-Key-M> to the dispatcher.
The proc the chord should reach: `wviewer::set_plot_mode invert $token`. Already flips the TARGET subwindow (SW22), pushes the status bar, logs on change.
Shape for the new %W wrapper: `wviewer::token_for_canvas $W`, return {} on a foreign canvas, call the token proc. No plot-mode wrapper exists; one must be added.
Options > Plot Mode entry (no accelerator today). Accelerators are static `-label {X} -accelerator Y` strings adjacent on one source line; menu_post changes only -label.
Sweeps widget-level binds, inserts WaveViewer at bindtags index 1, installs key_filter. Ordering: key_filter first (no break), then the class tag.
Sets readonly 0 around the forwarded m/d key, so readonly_block() answers 0 for any editor arm those keys reach.

The editor key switch. case 'M' Ctrl arm is the reported popup; case 's' cadence_compat arm, Alt arm and Ctrl+Alt arm, case 't' Ctrl+other-mods arm, case 'b' Alt arm, case 'm' Alt arm are the siblings.

C over-graph test (5*tk_scaling px `border` inset, skips on Alt/Super via SET_MODMASK, on excl ui_state, on graph_use_ctrl_key without Ctrl) and the graph key arms (a b s M m d t; A B further down), gated by access_cond.

Binding table consulted before the switch. Rows for the forwarded set: a/0 graph, a/ctrl graph, A/0 graph+canvas(view.toggle_show_netlist), A/ctrl graph, b/0 graph, B/0 graph+canvas(prop.edit_header_license_text, mutates=1), B/ctrl graph, d/0 canvas(edit.deselect_mode)+graph, s/ctrl graph, t/0 graph, t/ctrl graph. None for m, M, s/0.
The design-window chord -> ase::plot_mode_for_current invert. Sets cadence_compat 1. No binding of any M chord.
Design-window path: session -> wviewer::set_plot_mode, plus a CIW echo naming 'target subwindow plot mode' with two or more subwindows.
Only place the variable is defaulted. The viewer never sets it (src/xschemrc has it commented out).

existing_fences.covers: Real key delivery to the viewer canvas with a tk_messageBox recording stub (`::mb_hits`, answers ok) and a key_filter witness (`::kf_calls`, `::kf_last` = type/keysym/state). Delivery: `send_key` = focus -force, `event generate $w $ev` WITHOUT -when now, update, retry up to 200 times on a done-predicate. `ca_send` = <Motion> to the pixel, then the chord with -x/-y so Tcl and C geometry agree. Also calls `wviewer::key_filter` directly for arrows. No row drives M, plain s, or any Alt chord.
existing_fences.rows: G1s (sweep leaves only the allowed sequences), G5 (Insert/w/i reach the filter, no modal), G6 (Escape), G9a-c (Ctrl-W/Ctrl-Q), CA1-CA9 (Ctrl-A over a strip; CA4 asserts mb_hits unchanged)

existing_fences.covers: Per-subwindow plot mode and the Caps Lock dispatcher. Display band: `send_ks`/`ks_once` = focus -force, `event generate $w <KeyPress> -keysym K -state S` then KeyRelease, no -when now. Does NOT stub tk_messageBox. `swk_pairs` (the state 4/5/6/7 matrix) and SWK16's letter list are hand-kept and would have to gain `m`.
existing_fences.rows: SWK1/SWK2 (Options > Plot Mode flips the target subwindow, status bar follows), SWK4-SWK8 (real Ctrl-Shift-G/Ctrl-G/Ctrl-Shift-D, Caps Lock matrix), SWK14-SWK16 both arms (typed_upper, case_keysym, case_pairs letters `{d g n w e u b c q v}`), SWK18 (key_filter with `xschem callback` and over_graph replaced by recorders), SWE1 (Ctrl-Shift-4 echo)

existing_fences.covers: Source-level census, both arms: guide §9.1 `data-seq` rows vs `bind WaveViewer <seq>` statements in install_default_binds (both directions), and guide `data-menu`/`data-accel` pairs vs `-label {X} -accelerator Y` in build_menubar (both directions). Literal counts 20 keys / 15 accelerators.
BT09 pins the guide's counts as `[list 20 15]` and ties them to the bind statements and accelerators.
The five tab chords are WaveViewer defaults, call their `_at %W` proc, break, and are not bound on the canvas widget; bindtag position.

Band A evaluates quiz proofs that quote existing `bind WaveViewer <...> {...; break}` lines of src/wave_viewer.tcl verbatim; A8 fails when a topic has more than 6 questions ('Waveform viewer' has 6 now).

The only rows on the `set fwd` carve-out: BK01 regexps the exact expression text, BK02 extracts and evaluates it, BK03 pins graphkeys byte-exactly, BK10 pins guide counts `{20 15 1 1}` plus the two test_wave_grid literals.
MG4 Plot Mode submenu label and invoke; MG13 Ctrl+Shift+4 resolves to the dollar form (the one `-when now` use, on a scratch toplevel); rc text regexps for the two Ctrl-Shift-4 binds; MG16 u/U.
MXK: <KeyPress> routes to key_filter, graphkeys carries 109/100/77, Delete is not a member; MX rows drive m/d through `send_key_fb`. CLAUDE.md: this suite times out on the dev display (issue 1488).

C routing of graph keys over a graph embedded in a schematic, driven as `xschem callback .drw 2 x y <keysym> 0 0 <state>`. The place a C fence for the `case 's'` cadence arm would go. Sets graph_use_ctrl_key 0; never sets cadence_compat.
install_default_binds runs once and an rc binding wins (CG6, EG10); keysym 101 not in graphkeys (EG8); three highlight keys are defaults (WH9j).

specs_and_issues.rules: D7: Ctrl-Shift-4 on the schematic inverts the associated viewer's mode. §7/§7.1: set_plot_mode logs the RESOLVED mode with an explicit token, on change only. §8: one dynamic Options > Plot Mode entry, relabelled by -postcommand. §9: the chord path performs zero `new_schematic switch` calls (issue 0173). §14.3: viewer keys live on the WaveViewer bindtag, installed only when unbound, `{break}` disables.

SW21: plot mode and grid are per SUBWINDOW; the active one is the TARGET. SW22: Options > Plot Mode and Ctrl-Shift-4 change the target subwindow only; the status bar shows the target's mode. §16 Keys: <Control-Shift-Key-D>/<Control-Shift-Key-G> spellings. Caps Lock ruling 2026-10-16: the case as typed decides every Ctrl-letter pair; case_pairs lists each letter's two bases. §16 Rows text quotes 'GH0 (20 keys, 15 accelerators)'.

'The graphs OWN the viewer window' (issue 0149): no gesture may move the canvas; records the 5 px `border` inset as 'not a hole' for CLICKS only. Key-on-a-bindtag rule, rc wins, `{break}` not `{}`. States key_filter forwards only the waves_callback key set.

§6.1: `M` (Shift+m) was 'broken — no waves guard, ran readonly_block() + the cadence schematic move' and became the tooltip; 'Why the tooltip moved to M and not Ctrl+m' says M has no collision in either graph_use_ctrl_key mode. m/d are forwarded inside with_edit; read-only is enforced inside the marker ops.

Records what `reload` does to a viewer (graph rects dropped, readonly cleared) and states it is 'not reachable from the viewer's own keyboard'. By reading, Alt-s over a strip reaches `case 's'`'s reload arm, which contradicts that sentence.
Precedent for a chord whose C meaning differs from the bare key: a C half plus a Tcl carve-out in key_filter. Not opened in this pass; cited from source comments.
Precedent for the Ctrl-d carve-out and the WaveViewer bindtag. Not opened in this pass; cited from source comments.
§8.1 R9 and §10 limits 8/9 (the Ctrl-B carve-out and its declared price) as cited by comments in install_default_binds. Not opened in this pass.

family.sibling: Ctrl-Shift-M (keysym 77, state 5), pointer over a strip
family.same_cause: yes: allowlisted keysym, C arm for this modifier has no waves guard
family.evidence: READ: key_filter forwards 77 raw; `case 'M'` arm `rstate == ControlMask` opens with `if(readonly_block()) break;`. Popup every time; waves_selected is not consulted.

family.sibling: Caps Lock + Ctrl-m (state 6), or keysym M at state 4 with no Lock bit
family.evidence: READ: `wviewer::case_keysym` maps it to 77, then the same `case 'M'` Ctrl arm. Popup.

family.sibling: plain s (115, state 0) with cadence_compat 1 (the Cadence profile; src/cadence_style_rc sets it)
family.same_cause: yes: the cadence arm of `case 's'` has no waves guard
family.evidence: READ: `else if((rstate == 0) && cadence_compat)` goes semaphore test -> `readonly_block()` -> snapped_wire; only the `!cadence_compat` arm calls waves_selected. No table row for s/0. So `s` (documented as swap cursors) pops the read-only modal in the user's profile, and starts a snapped wire over a graph embedded in a schematic. No suite sets cadence_compat with a viewer.

family.sibling: Alt-s / Super-s (115, state 8 or 64), pointer over a strip
family.same_cause: yes: keysym allowlisted for every modifier
family.evidence: READ: `case 's'` EQUAL_MODMASK arm: tk_messageBox okcancel 'Are you sure you want to reload from disk?'; on ok unselect_all, remove_symbols, load_schematic. Issue 0186 describes what reload does to a viewer. Unconditional (waves_selected not consulted).
READ: `case 's'` arm `SET_MODMASK && (state & ControlMask)` -> `saveas(NULL, SYMBOL)` -> `save_as_cellview_dialog` (a modal form, not tk_messageBox). Unconditional.

READ: `case 't'` arm `rstate & ControlMask`; its guard calls waves_selected, which skips on SET_MODMASK, so it falls to `new_schematic("create", NULL, NULL, 1)`: a new schematic window/tab. Unconditional.

family.same_cause: yes: the Ctrl-b carve-out tests only `$s & 4`
family.evidence: READ: `case 'b'` EQUAL_MODMASK arm increments xctx->hide_symbols, writes the Tcl var hide_symbols, draw(). Silent editor view verb. Unconditional.

READ: key_filter forwards 109 inside `wviewer::with_edit` (readonly 0) for any modifier; `case 'm'` EQUAL_MODMASK arm: readonly_block() answers 0, then connect_by_kissing=2 and MENUSTART|MENUSTARTMOVE (or move_objects(START) under infix_interface). A move command is armed in the viewer context with no popup.

family.sibling: Tcl/C geometry disagreement: pointer in the `border` inset (5*tk_scaling px) just inside a strip edge, or ui_state in waves_selected's excl set, or a `lock=true` rect without Ctrl
family.same_cause: yes: key_filter decides with full graphbb bands, C re-decides with its own predicate and falls into the canvas arm
family.evidence: READ (both predicates; inferred for keys, see unverified). Canvas arms then reached: a -> 'do you want to make symbol view ?' dialog; b -> readonly_block; t -> readonly_block; Shift+M -> readonly_block; Shift+B -> prop.edit_header_license_text (mutates=1) -> readonly_block; Shift+A -> view.toggle_show_netlist; d -> edit.deselect_mode (inside with_edit); m and Ctrl-m -> stretch/move armed (inside with_edit, readonly bypassed); s without cadence_compat -> 'Run circuit simulation?' dialog; Ctrl-a -> select_all(); Ctrl-s -> saveas/save; Ctrl-t -> new_schematic create.

The tooltip chord that profile needs, Ctrl+Shift+M, is the popup arm, so the tooltip has no working key there; graph_markers.md §6.1 says otherwise.

family.sibling: NOT in the family (safe today when C agrees the pointer is over a graph)
family.evidence: READ: a/0, a/Ctrl, A/Shift, A/Ctrl+Shift, b/0, B/Shift, B/Ctrl+Shift, d/0, s/0 without cadence_compat, s/Ctrl, m/0, m/Ctrl, M/Shift, t/0, t/Ctrl reach waves_callback. Not forwarded: Ctrl-b, Ctrl-d, Ctrl-Alt-b, Ctrl-Alt-d, and every keysym outside graphkeys (S, T, D, ...). Forwarded but no C arm (inert): Alt-a, Alt-d, Alt-t, Alt-Shift-A/B/M, Ctrl-Alt-a, Ctrl-Alt-m, Ctrl-Alt-Shift-*. Escape is always forwarded to escape_terminal() by design (D10). f/Z/Ctrl-z are forwarded only when token_for_canvas answers {}.

design_options.name: A. Minimal: the new chord only (Tcl)
design_options.sketch: (1) New wrapper beside set_plot_mode, clear_all_at shape: token_for_canvas, {} on a foreign canvas, `wviewer::set_plot_mode invert $token`. (2) In install_default_binds: `if {[bind WaveViewer <Control-Shift-Key-M>] eq {}} { bind WaveViewer <Control-Shift-Key-M> {wviewer::<wrapper> %W; break} }`. (3) case_pairs row `m {} <Control-Shift-Key-M>`. (4) key_filter refuses to forward 77 under Control (the Ctrl-b/Ctrl-d shape; mandatory because key_filter runs before the tag and never breaks). (5) Optional `-accelerator Ctrl+Shift+M` on the Plot Mode entry. (6) Guide row and count literals.
design_options.risks: Leaves every other family member live: plain s in the Cadence profile, Alt-s reload prompt, Ctrl-Alt-s, Ctrl-Alt-t, Alt-b, Alt-m, the border band. First case_pairs row with an empty lower base. Conflicts with the user's standing 'fix the whole bug family' memory.
design_options.blast_radius: src/wave_viewer.tcl; doc/waveform_viewer_guide.html; literals in test_wave_grid GH0, test_wave_sigbrowser BT09, test_wave_sigbrowser_keys BK10; test_wave_subwindows SWK16 and swk_pairs; specs. No C, no rebuild.

design_options.name: B. Tcl allowlist by chord (closes the modifier family)
design_options.sketch: Option A plus: factor the forward decision into a pure proc of (case-mapped keysym, state), no Tk, that answers 1 only for chords whose C arm routes to waves_callback: never with Mod1 or Mod4 set; under Control only a, s, m, t, A, B; never Ctrl with b, d, M. key_filter calls it in place of the bare `lsearch graphkeys` + carve-out. graphkeys itself stays byte-identical.
design_options.risks: Does not close plain `s` under cadence_compat (the C arm decides) or the border-band disagreement. If the existing `set fwd [expr {...}]` line changes text, BK01/BK02 of the unregistered test_wave_sigbrowser_keys go red in full_audit.sh; either keep that line or update them in the same commit. The pure proc's table must be derived from the C arms and stated in one place.
design_options.blast_radius: As A, plus a counted-arm matrix row. No C.

design_options.name: C. C repair of the unguarded arms
design_options.sketch: In `handle_key_press`: give `case 's'`'s cadence arm the `case 'm'` idiom (`if(waves_selected(...)) { waves_callback(...); break; }` before readonly_block), and optionally the same guard on `case 'M'`'s Ctrl arm for schematic-embedded graphs.
design_options.risks: Changes behaviour over graphs embedded in schematics in the Cadence profile (`s` over a graph would swap cursors instead of starting a snapped wire). C edit: rebuild before any suite. Needs a fence in a suite that drives `xschem callback` directly; test_key_graph_context is unregistered and prints no OVERALL sentinel.
design_options.blast_radius: src/callback.c; every user of `s` over an embedded graph with cadence_compat 1; a registered C-level fence has to be created or an existing suite registered.

design_options.name: D. C backstop keyed on xctx->wave_viewer
design_options.sketch: At the top of `handle_key_press`, before the binding-table dispatch: when `xctx->wave_viewer` is set and the key is not Escape, call waves_callback only if waves_selected() answers, then return; a viewer context never enters the editor switch or a canvas table row. The flag is already set by the viewer (`xschem set wave_viewer 1`) and read in actions.c/scheduler.c.
design_options.risks: Closes the whole family including the border band, the graph_use_ctrl_key profile and future arms, but it is a behaviour change for every key sent to a viewer context by any route (`xschem callback` from scripts and tests included); the idle-only semantics of the a/b/Ctrl-s rows (skip at semaphore >= 2) must be kept; needs its own sweep of suites that drive keys into a viewer. C edit, rebuild.
design_options.blast_radius: src/callback.c; every viewer key suite (registered: test_wave_viewer, test_wave_subwindows, test_wave_tabs, test_wave_grid; unregistered: test_wave_markers, test_wave_modes, test_wave_clear_all, test_wave_empty_strips, test_wave_sigbrowser_keys).

recommended:
Build A + B in one unit, and C's `case 's'` guard if the user agrees to the embedded-graph change; treat D as a separate, optional hardening the user rules on. Reasons: A alone leaves six unconditional siblings and the user's memory says siblings get fixed in the same pass; B is pure Tcl and its decision can be fenced on the counted arm; plain `s` in the Cadence profile cannot be fixed from Tcl without either C or a Tcl-side reroute.

Concrete shape:
- Chord spelled `<Control-Shift-Key-M>` (the SW22 siblings' spelling) in `wviewer::install_default_binds`, as a literal `bind WaveViewer <...>` line (GH1/GH2 scan for that text), calling a new `_at %W` wrapper that ends in `wviewer::set_plot_mode invert $token`. That proc already targets the TARGET subwindow, pushes the status bar and logs, so no new model code.
- `wviewer::case_pairs` gains `m {} <Control-Shift-Key-M>` so Caps Lock + Ctrl-m does the same and Caps Lock + Ctrl-Shift-M stays the engine's Ctrl-m.
- key_filter stops forwarding Ctrl+M and every Alt/Super chord, via a pure decision proc; `graphkeys` and the existing `set fwd` line stay byte-identical unless BK01/BK02 are updated with them.
- Menu: `-label {Set Multi-plot Mode} -accelerator Ctrl+Shift+M` adjacent on one line (plot_mode_menu_post only rewrites -label), with a guide row carrying `data-seq`, `data-menu="Set Multi-plot Mode"`, `data-accel`; GH0/BT09/BK10 literals move 20->21 and 15->16 in the same commit.
- Put the red-first real-key row in test_wave_viewer (dcases), the only registered suite that stubs tk_messageBox; put census and pure rows in test_wave_subwindows / test_wave_grid, which are in both lists.
- The private tree carries the same code (key_filter, case_pairs, install_default_binds, same graphkeys, no M binding), so the port hand-over applies.

Sabotage acceptance for the unit: remove the key_filter refusal and the real-key row must redden on mb_hits; remove the bind and it must redden on the mode; restore the old keysym-only decision and the matrix must redden on exactly the seven must-refuse legs.
